subject.title: feat(anthropic): gate live model discovery on contract coverage

question: Should OpenClaw support a documented provider-level `acceptUnknownModel` admission hook as the stage-1 solution for Anthropic discovery, or defer this policy surface until capability-driven contracts are defined?
rationale: The branch is mechanically narrow, but it creates a Plugin SDK contract and selects one of the alternatives still explicitly open in the canonical product discussion.

options.title: Approve the narrow stage-1 hook
options.body: Accept the hidden-until-supported policy, document the callback’s supported semantics and fallback behavior, and retain the focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Defer to capability-driven contracts
options.body: Do not add the callback yet; keep static coverage until the broader contract layer can shape newly discovered models directly.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow stage-1 hook
recommendation.body: Accept the hidden-until-supported policy, document the callback’s supported semantics and fallback behavior, and retain the focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged live-catalog implementation and authored the canonical Anthropic direction discussion and this follow-up.
